independent CD-02 detector fires on canonical bytes and does NOT fire on candidate bytes

FROZEN rev28 still pins F2b at 55d0a1ea and remains unchanged at exit

controls.desc: revert REP-CD-01 only in the candidate -> CD-01 detector fires again (single-defect revert)
revert REP-CD-02 only in the candidate -> CD-02 detector fires again (single-defect revert)
mutate candidate 'smaller' -> 'larger' in the repaired reason -> CD-01 detector fires (mutation sensitivity)
mutate the declared chain to the false direction (E_C2 contains E_C0) -> C5 fails
pristine candidate copy -> both detectors stay silent (no false positive)
canonical copy with a whitespace-only perturbation -> both detectors still fire (detectors are not keyed to exact file identity)

verdict_rule: REPAIR_READY iff C1-C10 all pass and M1-M6 all behave as specified. Otherwise REPAIR_FAILED or PIN_VOID (C1/C9 failure voids the binding rather than the finding).
falsifier: FALSIFIED IF any of: (a) the canonical F2b hash is not 55d0a1ea9bda at entry (pin moved -> binding void, re-pin and re-run); (b) CD-01/CD-02 no longer fire on the pinned canonical bytes under the independent detectors (nothing left to repair); (c) the emitted candidate still trips C3 or C4, changes any line outside the two intended fields, fails C6/C7, or is non-deterministic; (d) any of M1-M6 does not fire/clear as specified; (e) FROZEN rev28 is already re-pinned to a repaired F2b (candidate superseded).
authority_note: Worker-level candidate and self-check only. Does not set any node status, validation_status, review verdict, gate verdict, or canonical byte. Publication and re-freeze remain with the formulation lead and the controller.
